params.body:
## What

A follow-up on #91, tuning the story page for long reading.

- **Image on the left.** The head of a story keeps the photo and text block from Over ons, now with the image left and the title right. That is the side the image has on the featured story on `/stories` and on a frame page, so it stays put from the overview to the article.
- **Reading column.** The story runs in 640px at 16px, line height 1.75: about 70 characters a line instead of about 90. The lead is 17px.
- **Galleries step out** of the column to 960px on a wide screen, so their images stay large. Below 1040px they fit the column again.
- **Phone.** A gallery of three opens with one image across the width and two under it, instead of two and one left over.

## Checked

- `StoriesTest`, `BlogTest` and `PaginaTitelTest` pass (43 tests); `StoriesTest` asserts the image-left head. Pint passes.
- Looked at locally on desktop and mobile with the two published stories (H8 & F8, Repair Kit).
params.title: Put the story image on the left and tune the reading column
